frame_stride.description: Process every Nth frame. Recorded so the effective rate is measured, never assumed.

batch_size.description: Aligned faces per forward pass. Results are identical batched or single (measured max difference 6e-8); batching only saves setup.

emit_lateral.description: Also emit the 14 left/right units (AU01_L ... AU14_R). Off by default: no per-side reliability figure exists in the evidence base for any AU, and no other engine here emits them, so they cannot be cross-checked.

torch_threads.description: CPU threads for this engine's forward passes; 0 means all cores. Set explicitly and restored afterwards, because Py-Feat forces OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 process-wide on import and this network then runs ~20x slower.

signals.description: Per-AU OCCURRENCE scores (cosine similarity to a learned AU prototype, thresholded at 0.5 upstream) — not intensities, and not calibrated probabilities. 27 bilateral units; the 18 shared with face.pyfeat_aus carry the same channel names so the two engines pair for §2.2 agreement without a mapping table. Tier is set per AU from the shared contract table.
Whether a face was found and aligned. Detection here is MediaPipe, not Py-Feat's RetinaFace, so the two engines' denominators differ — which §2.2 says is itself a finding.

quality.description: Effective AU sampling rate after frame_stride.
Engine-specific; never comparable across engines as a property of the recording.

Median share of the aligned 224px crop that fell outside the video frame and was filled black. A face at the frame edge is analysed on partly-invented pixels; this makes that visible rather than silent.

license.notes: CODE is Apache-2.0 (repo LICENSE, read 2026-09-22); the model code is vendored in server/graphau_model.py with the notice and a list of modifications. The WEIGHTS carry no licence of their own and were trained on BP4D, DISFA, RAF-AU, Aff-Wild2, CK+ and CASME II, whose EULAs are believed research-only and were NOT individually verified. Fine under this project's academic/non-profit position; marked `unknown` so the commercial gate treats it as unverified. Face detection uses the MediaPipe face_landmarker bundle, whose own licence line is likewise unverified.

provenance.published_performance: Upstream reports average F1 23.24 / accuracy 93.31 over all 41 units on its hybrid test split, at threshold 0.5. No per-AU figures are published. The average is dragged down by rare units, but it is the only number upstream gives and it is reported here unflattered.
